2027 GSDSEF Schedule

The 2027 GSDSEF will be held at the Balboa Park Activity Center in Balboa Park.

2027 Application (Tab 8) & Payment Deadline

February 19, 2027, 11:59pm - all GSDSEF Applications and Payments are due.

2027 GSDSEF Fair Week Dates

March 8-14, 2027, at the Balboa Park Activity Center (BPAC)

Monday, March 8, 2027: 10am-5pm - Fair Setup

Tuesday, March 9, 2027: Fair Setup, Student project setup at the BPAC.

Wednesday, March 10, 2027: 8:00-11:30am - Category Awards Judging; 11:45am-2:00pm - Special Awards Judging; 12:30-3:00pm - Grand Awards Judging.

Thursday, March 11, 2027: 6:30-9:00pm - Awards Ceremony (The Magnolia, El Cajon).

Friday, March 12, 2027: BPAC closed to the public. Open for student tours.

Saturday, March 13, 2027: 10am-1pm - BPAC open to public to view projects. 1-3pm - Project pickup.

Sunday, March 14, 2027: 10am-1pm - Project pickup. 1-6pm - BPAC Cleanup.
